name: Boots of Blasting
description:
When a creature puts on the boots for the first time, reset the Difficulty of the boots to 15.

Once per day, the wearer may tap the heels together to activate the boots. Five seconds after activating, the boots discharge a burst of flame downward from the heels, propelling the wearer 30 ft. The wearer must roll Dexterity against the Difficulty. On a success, the wearer is propelled in a direction of their choice. On a failure, they are propelled in a random direction.
successes:
✨: Reduce the Difficulty by 1.

🌞: Reduce the Difficulty by 3.
